title: Sector Lead (Energy & Industrials) - Directed Content
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead (Energy & Industrials) on our Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research for E&I you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.</li> <li>Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution</li> <li>Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.</li> <li>Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.</li> <li>Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.</li> <li>Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Energy & Industrials sector, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within Energy & Industrials (E&I)</li> <li>You bring deep domain expertise in Energy & Industrials (E&I) with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.</li> <li>You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.</li> <li>You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.</li> <li>You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.</li> <li>You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.</li> <li>You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.</li> <li>You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.</li> </ul> AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p> </p></div><p><em><span data-contrast="none">By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. </span></em><a href="https://www.geniussports.com/about-us/"><em><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">Learn more at geniussports.com.</span></span></em></a><span data-contrast="none"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><br>The Role</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will join one of our established high-performing teams within the Betting division, as we invest in our core and future Betting products. You will be focusing on the delivery of technical and product-focused initiatives, to expand and scale up our industry's leading Sportsbook and Risk Management products.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">One example is our Advanced Risk team, who were set up to challenge conventional wisdom about risk management for sports betting operators. Using new measures of liability that take account of correlations between different markets on an event, and by monitoring betting patterns from the moment an event is opened for betting, we apply margins asymmetrically in a way that helps operators to make higher profit margins, reduce volatility and improve customer experience with greater uptime and fewer rejected bets. Our software provides customers with a new level of flexibility over the way they manage their Sportsbooks to meet their financial objectives. Smart algorithms allow decisions about bets to be taken quickly at scale while enabling close control when desired, reminiscent of earlier days of sports betting.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><br></span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How will you work?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Join a specially formed, highly skilled team delivering an innovative & intelligent product! You will be responsible for innovating, architecting, delivering & maintaining an industry-revolutionising product. You will lead execution of multi-sprint features or systems with measurable business impact.  </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We will lean on your technical expertise and your pragmatic approach to problem solving; working in a team that prioritises the principles of Agile delivery and continuous improvement. title: Engineering Director
description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We're looking for an ambitious and talented Director of Engineering to join Omnea, the UK's #1 Startup in 2026 , as a senior member of our Engineering leadership team. You'll report directly to our CTO, Dhruv Kumar , who joined us from Voy and has scaled engineering organizations at Hopin, Charlotte Tilbury, and THG. This is a manager-of-managers role. You'll lead a group of Engineering Managers and Team Leads: 25-50 engineers across several teams. You'll own the outcomes, org design, and technical direction of a significant slice of the product. As we grow from tens to hundreds of enterprise customers and through 10x revenue growth in the next 2-3 years, you'll play a crucial role in building the best Engineering function in its category. You'll operate with high autonomy, partnering with the CTO, Product leadership, and your peers across R&D to turn strategy into shipped software. What you’ll do Build and lead the leaders: Hire, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and Team Leads. Your primary output is their effectiveness, not your own. Set and hold a high performance bar across the group, including the harder calls on performance and leveling. Own org design for your area: how teams are shaped, sized, and split as the product and company grow. Build the bench: identify and grow the next generation of engineering leaders at Omnea. Own the headcount plan for your group, from business case through to hiring. Own delivery at group scale: Be accountable for the outcomes of several teams at once, not the output of any one of them. Create the operating rhythm (planning, prioritization, and reporting) that keeps a multi-team group moving quickly and predictably. Unblock at the seams: the cross-team dependencies, ambiguous ownership, and architectural decisions that no single team can resolve. Ensure robust monitoring, observability, and incident response across your area. Shape technical and product strategy: Partner with the CTO and Product leadership to define and execute the technical roadmap for your domain. Make the build/buy, architecture, and technical investment calls that shape the platform for years, and bring the rest of R&D with you. Balance technical debt, feature development, and reliability, and be able to defend those trade-offs to the exec team. Ensure customer feedback drives technical priorities, including direct time with enterprise customers. Teams and products you might end up working on: Accounting and Goods Receipting – ensuring procurement and finance teams have the right information and tools to operate accurately, automatically, and at scale. Insights and Reporting – deep, complex custom visualizations bringing together AI and data to surface meaningful insights and context across the platform. Sourcing – building the tools that find the right suppliers, shape the right deals, and make sure the best option is already in play before a request is even created. Workflow Orchestration – the configurable backbone of our systems that accurately model company operations, underpinning a single source of truth. And many more areas we’re actively starting or expanding upon! About You Leadership Experience: You have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering leadership. You have 2+ years managing managers, having hired, coached, and where necessary, performance-managed Engineering Managers or Team Leads. You've led a group of 25-50 engineers across multiple teams and owned the org design for it. You've demonstrated success in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, particularly in rapid-growth periods. Ideally, you've done this at more than one company, including at least one successful Series A+ B2B SaaS company. Technical Excellence: Strong technical background with hands-on experience in modern web technologies. Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture (preferably AWS), and scalability challenges. Experience with our stack (TypeScript, React, AWS Serverless) is a plus, but not required. Track Record of Impact: Strong track record of delivering complex, multi-team programs that moved company outcomes: product adoption, revenue, and customer retention. Proven history of improving team velocity and quality at the group level, not just within a single team. Experience scaling an engineering organization through a period of rapid growth and adapting the structure as it grew. Experience implementing engineering processes that scale effectively at pace. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating their needs into technical solutions. Leadership Style: You're data-driven but know when to trust intuition. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and owning them when they don't land. You excel at influence without authority, across Product, Design, GTM, and the exec team. You have a track record of growing and developing engineering leaders, as well as engineers at all levels (Senior, Staff, Principal). You stay close enough to the technology to be credible with senior engineers without taking the work off them. Nice to haves that really stand out to us: Track record of successful product launches in B2B SaaS. Experience with procurement/finance systems. History of contributions to engineering communities. You can learn more about Engineering at Omnea and our hiring process via our R&D Candidate Hub here . At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! title: Growth Creative Designer, International
description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. title: Founding Operations & Systems Lead
description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software. The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it. You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work. We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else. What you'll own Deal Execution: Getting investments from idea to closed as fast as possible for the fund managers and deal sponsors who run their businesses on Odin. Automation: You'll work alongside the deal operations team, with a standing instruction to automate their work. You'll bring product/design/engineering into the things that genuinely need significant engineering work, but you’ll mainly work autonomously without them. Before it gets to them you've already made the process as simple and fast as possible, and usually vibe coded something that works well but perhaps needs to be stabilised / scaled. Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it. What we're looking for AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more. Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting. In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done. First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that. Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you. You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority How we work There are five things we care about deeply: Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster. This role is probably not for you if You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is; You prefer close management of your responsibilities; You are risk-averse; You want a 9-5; You take yourself too seriously; You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact Salary £70k - £90k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity. Hiring process Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. Location & ways of working We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office. description: <p>Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.<br><br>Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.</p> <h3>The Role</h3> <p>Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.</p> <p>This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.</p> <p>You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.</p> <p>If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.</p> <h3>You will:</h3> <p><strong>Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.</li> <li>Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.</li> <li>Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.</li> <li>Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Master your verticals and sell with precision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.</li> <li>Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout title: Director, EMEA Marketing
description: About G2 - The Company G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users. Now, we have joined forces with Capterra , SoftwareAdvice , and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence. And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI. Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK! About G2 - Our People At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— ( P erformance + E ntrepreneurship + A uthenticity + K indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn. You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people. About The Role G2 is looking for a commercially minded marketing leader who is passionate about the software industry and excited to help build G2 EMEA. This role reports to the VP, EMEA and leads marketing for the region, with one direct report. Three things sit at the centre of this job. You own the pipeline G2 generates in EMEA. You own the EMEA event calendar and the pipeline that comes out of it. And you are the connection between the region and G2's central Growth Marketing team, in both directions. Central Growth Marketing markets to buyer personas globally. This role owns the market. You decide what EMEA needs, secure it, adapt it, build what only the region can build, and own the number at the end of it. You also work the other way round: finding the triggers and signals that convert in this region and feeding them back into the global model. You will be the marketing voice on the EMEA leadership team, and you will have the autonomy that comes with sitting in the region rather than at the centre. As the Director, EMEA Marketing, you will be a key player in our mission to build the largest and most trusted global software marketplace. In This Role, You Will: Own the EMEA marketing plan, budget, and pipeline target. Serve as the marketing voice on the EMEA leadership team and the EMEA voice within central marketing. Translate G2's global GTM strategy into a regional plan built for how European buyers actually buy. Drive EMEA pipeline growth and conversion, covering the full volume of demand generated and how well it converts. Lead EMEA event strategy and execution (executive dinners, sponsored events, partner events, virtual formats), including format, audience, calendar, and spend. Lead the EMEA account-based marketing program, using buyer intent and account signals to prioritize target accounts. Run the weekly pipeline and funnel review with EMEA sales leadership, and manage the marketing-to-sales handoff. Partner with central Growth Marketing to adapt global campaigns and signals for EMEA, feeding regional results back into the global model. Forecast and report on MQA, SQLA, pipeline, revenue, and average contract value using Salesforce and Looker. Manage, coach, and develop one direct report. Minimum Qualifications: We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 7+ years of B2B marketing experience 2+ years leading a lean marketing team in a player-coach capacity, balancing hands-on execution with people management You have hands-on experience designing digital one-to-one and one-to-few ABM campaigns, overseeing event efforts, as well as planning and executing. bottom-of-the-funnel activation programmes. You have owned an event strategy and run executive-level formats that produced pipeline, not just attendance. You’ve previously worked in a B2B company in the sales and marketing tech category. You’ve previously developed and executed an enterprise marketing plan in partnership with Account Development, Sales, and Customer Success teams. You have turned buyer intent or behavioural signals into campaigns that converted, and can show which signals worked and which did not. You’re motivated by results and contribution to pipeline/revenue. You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy creating new ways of working. What Can Help Your Application Stand Out: Have been a G2 customer. G2's growth function is moving towards AI-orchestrated plays and this role is part of that. Experience building a customer community in a region. title: Interaction Designer, HCI
description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations. Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things. Role You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing. This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows. There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up. What You'll Be Doing Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks. Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered. Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging. Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery. Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff. Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns. Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction. Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3>The role</h3> <p>Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.</p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist within our Payment Intelligence team, you’ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You’ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.</p> <p>At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the end-to-end delivery of models at scale, from initial discovery and feature engineering to production, A/B testing and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and engineering peers to turn complex data into real-time, mission-critical fraud prevention solutions.</li> <li>Raise the team’s collective bar through hands-on technical leadership and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Proactively research and integrate latest developments in ML and payer fraud prevention to drive innovation at GoCardless.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being a self-starter who thrives on taking a vague business problem and owning the journey from the first prototype to a live, measurable solution.</li> <li>An opportunity to introduce and scale advanced architectures to solve high-stakes fraud and payment challenges.</li> <li>Moving beyond execution to help define the technical roadmap for Payer Fraud Prevention, ensuring we leverage the best tools for the job.</li> <li>Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites us</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You hold a degree (or PhD) in a STEM discipline or an equivalent commercial experience.</li> <li>You bring hands-on experience with sophisticated architectures, such as deep learning, graph-based, or sequence-based models (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).</li> <li>You can translate complex ML concepts into practical product solutions and communicate these ideas clearly to non-technical peers.</li> <li>You are comfortable owning the full lifecycle, from deep-dive analysis and feature engineering to prototyping, validation, and live A/B testing.</li> <li>You lead by example, writing clean, high-quality code and raising the team’s technical bar through knowledge sharing and code best practices.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> £99,200 - £148,800</p> <p> </p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">minimum and the mid-point</span> of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Life at GoCardless  </strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our <a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/">values</a>; We <em>start with why </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We<em> act with integrity</em>, always. We <em>care deeply</em> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <em>be humble </em>whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work. </p> <h3><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — <strong>25%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Neurodiverse — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">LGBTQIA+ — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Disabled — <strong>1%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Average age — <strong>33</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Female — <strong>45%</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Male — <strong> 55% </strong></p> <p>We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.</p> <p>If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives <u><a href="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://gocardless.com/about/careers/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1781014616204220&usg=AOvVaw1DeqgyeRfEwEzecwn4oq3j" target="_blank">here</a></u><br><br><strong>Sustainability</strong><br><br>We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability <u><a href="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://gocardless.com/sustainability/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1781014616204220&usg=AOvVaw0OQGUkwNEPbDW9lQb1uiAd" target="_blank">action plan</a></u> here.</p> <p>Find out more about Life at GoCardless via <a href="http://twitter.com/GoCardlessEng">Twitter</a>, <a href="http://instagram.com/lifeatgocardless">Instagram</a> and <a href="http://linkedin.com/company/gocardless">LinkedIn</a>. </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? This means assessing what's out there, testing what fits, and identifying where it can raise the quality and scale of our creative output.</p> <p><strong>Tooling selection and RFP:</strong> Running RFPs for Marketing tooling, particularly for a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. This means familiarity with the tooling, integrations, data, and vendors that make up a marketing tech stack. </li> <li>You're comfortable building and integrating AI in a regulated or high-governance environment. You design for data protection, compliance, and the right human controls from the start, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>You possess excellent communication skills, translating between the business need and the technical detail so everyone's working to the same picture.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? title: General Counsel
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones, with an option to be office based in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>
